source.servicedesk:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../flow.schema.json
# Service desk: Jira Service Management's IT service management flows, written in
# this format to check how much of them it can express (case-study-tickets.md §7).
# Statuses are those Atlassian lists as Jira Service Management's defaults.
module: servicedesk
categories: [waiting, active, pending, inactive]

enumerations:
  Priority: [HIGHEST, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, LOWEST]
  Level: [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW]
  Resolution: [DONE, WONT_DO, DUPLICATE, KNOWN_ERROR, HARDWARE_FAILURE, SOFTWARE_FAILURE]
  RequestType: [GET_IT_HELP, REQUEST_ACCESS, NEW_HARDWARE]
  ChangeType: [STANDARD, NORMAL, EMERGENCY]
  Risk: [LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH]
  Decision: [APPROVE, DECLINE]
  ReviewStage: [PEER, CAB]
  WindowKind: [MAINTENANCE, FREEZE]
  AlertPriority: [P1, P2, P3, P4, P5]
  SupportLevel: [STANDARD, PLATINUM]

sequences:
  asset_key:
    description: Numbers the configuration items of the asset schema, as IT-42.

machines:
  AssetLifecycle:
    description: An asset's status, active, pending or inactive, from receipt to disposal.
    requires:
      attributes:
        name:    { type: string }
        service: { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true }
    states:
      IN_STOCK: { category: pending }
      IN_USE:   { category: active }
      RETIRED:  { category: inactive }
      DISPOSED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      receive: { kind: initial, to: IN_STOCK, required_inputs: [name] }
      deploy:  { kind: external, from: IN_STOCK, to: IN_USE, optional_inputs: [service] }
      retire:  { kind: external, from: [IN_STOCK, IN_USE], to: RETIRED }
      dispose: { kind: external, from: RETIRED, to: DISPOSED }

types:
  Organization:
    description: A group of customers whose requests are shared among its members.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      name:          { type: string }
      support_level: { type: SupportLevel }
      requests:      { reference: "Request[]", opposite: organization }
    states:
      ACTIVE:   { category: active }
      ARCHIVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      create:  { kind: initial, to: ACTIVE, required_inputs: [name, support_level] }
      archive: { kind: external, from: ACTIVE, to: ARCHIVED }

  RegisteredService:
    description: A service in the service registry, with the people who respond to its incidents and approve its changes.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      name:             { type: string }
      tier:             { type: int }
      responders:       { type: "identity[]" }
      change_approvers: { type: "identity[]" }
      incidents:        { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: affected_service }
      changes:          { reference: "Change[]", opposite: affected_service }
      assets:           { reference: "Asset[]", opposite: service }
    states:
      OPERATIONAL: { category: active }
      RETIRED:     { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      register: { kind: initial, to: OPERATIONAL, required_inputs: [name, tier, responders, change_approvers] }
      retire:   { kind: external, from: OPERATIONAL, to: RETIRED }

  Request:
    description: A service request raised by a customer, approved where it needs to be, and measured against its SLA goals.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:            { type: string }
      request_type:       { type: RequestType }
      reporter:           { type: identity, description: The customer who raised it. }
      organization:       { reference: Organization, optional: true, opposite: requests }
      participants:       { type: "identity[]" }
      approvers:          { type: "identity[]" }
      approvals_required: { type: int, optional: true, description: How many approvals it needs; all of its approvers when absent. }
      priority:           { type: Priority, default: Priority.MEDIUM, description: A customer's request is medium until an agent says otherwise. }
      opened_at:          { type: timestamp }
      resolution:         { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      resolved_at:        { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      sla_met:            { type: bool, optional: true, description: "Whether the resolution goal was met, fixed when it was resolved." }
    observations:
      replies:
        kind: PublicReply
        description: A comment visible to the customer.
        attributes:
          body: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      notes:
        kind: InternalNote
        description: A comment the service team alone sees; who may read it is the application's.
        attributes:
          body: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      approvals:
        kind: RequestApproval
        description: One approver's decision on the request.
        attributes:
          approver: { type: identity }
          decision: { type: Decision }
      ratings:
        kind: SatisfactionRating
        description: The customer's rating of how the request was handled.
        attributes:
          score: { type: int }
        invariants:
          in_range:
            description: A score is from 1 to 5.
            expression: score >= 1 and score <= 5
    states:
      WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL: { category: pending }
      WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT:  { category: waiting }
      IN_PROGRESS:          { category: active }
      WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER: { category: pending }
      PENDING:              { category: pending }
      ESCALATED:            { category: active }
      RESOLVED:
        description: Resolved, and awaiting the customer's verification.
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [resolution]
      DECLINED:  { category: closed }
      CANCELED:  { category: closed }
      CLOSED:
        description: Finished; the resolution is correct.
        category: closed
        final: true
    derived_attributes:
      approvals_needed:
        description: The approvals the request needs, a given number or all of its approvers.
        expression: if approvals_required is not null then approvals_required else count(a in approvers)
      resolution_goal:
        description: The time to resolution its SLA allows, by priority, and shorter for a platinum organization.
        expression: >-
          if organization is not null and organization.support_level == SupportLevel.PLATINUM then 2 h
          else if priority == Priority.HIGHEST or priority == Priority.HIGH then 4 h
          else if priority == Priority.MEDIUM then 8 h else 16 h
      time_to_resolution:
        description: Time spent on the request, paused while it waits for the customer or is pending.
        expression: >-
          sum(i in this.intervals where i.state != WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER and i.state != PENDING
              and i.state != WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL and i.state != RESOLVED and i.state != DECLINED
              and i.state != CANCELED and i.state != CLOSED: i.duration)
      resolution_breached:
        description: The request has taken longer than its goal.
        expression: time_to_resolution > resolution_goal
      paused:
        description: The request's SLA clock is paused.
        expression: state == WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER or state == PENDING
      time_to_first_response:
        description: From opening to the first comment the customer can see.
        expression: >-
          min(r in replies: r.occurred_at) - opened_at
    summary: [summary, request_type, priority, state]
    conditions:
      has_approvers:
        description: At least one approver is named.
        expression: count(a in inputs.approvers) >= 1
        remedy: self_serviceable
      approved:
        description: Enough approvers other than the reporter have approved since the request began waiting for approval.
        expression: >-
          count(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.APPROVE and o.approver != reporter
                and o.occurred_at > entered_at(WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL)) >= approvals_needed
        remedy: dependent
      declined:
        description: An approver has declined since the request began waiting for approval.
        expression: >-
          any(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.DECLINE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL))
        remedy: dependent
      resolved_three_days:
        description: The request has been resolved for three days.
        expression: entered_at(RESOLVED) + 3 days <= now
        remedy: temporal
    transitions:
      raise:
        kind: initial
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: Raises a request that needs no approval.
        required_inputs: [summary, request_type, reporter]
        optional_inputs: [organization]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      raise_for_approval:
        kind: initial
        to: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        description: Raises a request that its approvers must approve first.
        required_inputs: [summary, request_type, reporter, approvers]
        optional_inputs: [organization, approvals_required]
        guards:
          has_approvers: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      approve:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        guards:
          approved: deny
      decline:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        to: DECLINED
        guards:
          declined: deny
      start:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, ESCALATED]
        to: IN_PROGRESS
      respond_to_customer:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED]
        to: WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER
      customer_replies:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: The customer answers, and the request waits for the team again.
      pend:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS]
        to: PENDING
      resume:
        kind: external
        from: PENDING
        to: IN_PROGRESS
      escalate:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS]
        to: ESCALATED
      prioritise:
        kind: internal
        from: [WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        description: Sets the priority an agent judges the request to have.
        required_inputs: [priority]
      share:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        description: Shares the request with another customer, who becomes a participant.
        inputs:
          with: { type: identity }
        effect:
          - add: { location: participants, expr: inputs.with }
      resolve:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED, PENDING]
        to: RESOLVED
        required_inputs: [resolution]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: resolved_at, expr: now }
          - assign: { location: sla_met, expr: time_to_resolution <= resolution_goal }
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: Reopens a resolved request, as a customer's comment on it does.
        effect:
          - clear: [resolution, resolved_at, sla_met]
      cancel:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        to: CANCELED
      close:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: CLOSED
        description: Closes a request resolved three days ago; a schedule in the application requests it.
        guards:
          resolved_three_days: deny
    metrics:
      sla_success:
        description: The share of resolved requests that met their resolution goal, by month.
        source: objects
        item: r
        filter: r.sla_met is not null
        dimensions:
          month: month(r.resolved_at)
        time_dimension: r.resolved_at
        expression: count(where r.sla_met) * 1.000 / count()
      labels_by_state:
        description: How often each label is applied to requests, by the state they were in, which shows where the flow and the work disagree.
        source: labels
        item: l
        dimensions:
          name: l.name
          state: l.subject_state
        time_dimension: l.occurred_at
        expression: count()
      satisfaction:
        description: The average satisfaction score, by month.
        source: ratings
        item: s
        dimensions:
          month: month(s.occurred_at)
        time_dimension: s.occurred_at
        expression: avg(s.score)

  Incident:
    description: An unplanned disruption to a service, prioritised by its impact and urgency.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:          { type: string }
      impact:           { type: Level }
      urgency:          { type: Level }
      major:            { type: bool }
      affected_service: { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      asset:            { reference: Asset, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      problem:          { reference: Problem, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      responders:       { type: "identity[]" }
      opened_at:        { type: timestamp }
      resolution:       { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      alerts:           { reference: "Alert[]", opposite: incident }
      reviews:          { reference: "PostIncidentReview[]", opposite: primary_incident }
    observations:
      timeline:
        kind: StakeholderUpdate
        description: An update to the incident's stakeholders, on its timeline.
        attributes:
          message: { type: string }
    states:
      OPEN:             { category: waiting }
      WORK_IN_PROGRESS: { category: active }
      PENDING:          { category: pending }
      ESCALATED:        { category: active }
      RESOLVED:
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [resolution]
      CANCELED: { category: closed }
      CLOSED:   { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      priority:
        description: The priority its impact and urgency give it, by the impact and urgency matrix.
        expression: >-
          if impact == Level.CRITICAL and urgency == Level.CRITICAL then Priority.HIGHEST
          else if impact == Level.CRITICAL or urgency == Level.CRITICAL then Priority.HIGH
          else if impact == Level.LOW and urgency == Level.LOW then Priority.LOW
          else Priority.MEDIUM
      time_to_resolution:
        description: Time spent on the incident, paused while it is pending.
        expression: >-
          sum(i in this.intervals where i.state != PENDING and i.state != RESOLVED
              and i.state != CANCELED and i.state != CLOSED: i.duration)
      problem_open:
        description: The problem that causes the incident is still open, which Jira Service Management reports by automation.
        expression: problem is not null and problem.state.category != closed
    conditions:
      resolved_three_days:
        description: The incident has been resolved for three days.
        expression: entered_at(RESOLVED) + 3 days <= now
        remedy: temporal
    transitions:
      open:
        kind: initial
        to: OPEN
        required_inputs: [summary, impact, urgency, major, responders]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      investigate: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS }
      pend:        { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS], to: PENDING }
      resume:      { kind: external, from: PENDING, to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS }
      escalate:    { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS], to: ESCALATED }
      mark_major:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: major, expr: "true" }
      set_affected_service:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        description: Sets the affected service, whose responders join the incident's.
        required_inputs: [affected_service]
        effect:
          - foreach:
              item: r
              array: inputs.affected_service.responders
              limit: 100
              steps:
                - add: { location: responders, expr: r }
      link_problem:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        required_inputs: [problem]
      link_asset:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        description: Names the asset the incident affects, a configuration item of the asset schema.
        required_inputs: [asset]
      resolve:
        kind: external
        from: [WORK_IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED, PENDING]
        to: RESOLVED
        required_inputs: [resolution]
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS
        effect:
          - clear: [resolution]
      cancel: { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED], to: CANCELED }
      close:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: CLOSED
        guards:
          resolved_three_days: deny
      create_review:
        kind: internal
        from: [RESOLVED]
        description: Creates a post-incident review with this incident as its primary incident.
        inputs:
          title: { type: string }
        effect:
          - create: { type: PostIncidentReview, transition: draft, inputs: { primary_incident: this, title: inputs.title } }
    metrics:
      incidents_opened:
        description: Incidents opened, by month.
        source: objects
        item: i
        dimensions:
          month: month(i.created_at)
        time_dimension: i.created_at
        expression: count()

  PostIncidentReview:
    description: A review of why an incident happened and how to prevent it.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      title:            { type: string }
      primary_incident: { reference: Incident, opposite: reviews }
      findings:         { type: string, optional: true }
    states:
      DRAFT:     { category: active }
      PUBLISHED: { category: closed, required_attributes: [findings] }
      ARCHIVED:  { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      draft:   { kind: initial, to: DRAFT, required_inputs: [primary_incident, title] }
      publish: { kind: external, from: DRAFT, to: PUBLISHED, required_inputs: [findings] }
      archive: { kind: external, from: [DRAFT, PUBLISHED], to: ARCHIVED }

  Problem:
    description: The cause, or possible cause, of one or more incidents.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:    { type: string }
      root_cause: { type: string, optional: true }
      workaround: { type: string, optional: true }
      resolution: { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      incidents:  { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: problem }
      changes:    { reference: "Change[]", opposite: problem }
    states:
      OPEN:                { category: waiting }
      UNDER_INVESTIGATION: { category: active }
      UNDER_REVIEW:
        category: active
        required_attributes: [root_cause]
      COMPLETED:
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [root_cause, resolution]
      CANCELED: { category: closed }
      ARCHIVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      open:        { kind: initial, to: OPEN, required_inputs: [summary] }
      investigate: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: UNDER_INVESTIGATION }
      review:
        kind: external
        from: UNDER_INVESTIGATION
        to: UNDER_REVIEW
        required_inputs: [root_cause]
        optional_inputs: [workaround]
      complete:
        kind: external
        from: UNDER_REVIEW
        to: COMPLETED
        description: Completes the problem; a documented workaround makes it a known error.
        required_inputs: [resolution]
      cancel:  { kind: external, from: [OPEN, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, UNDER_REVIEW], to: CANCELED }
      archive: { kind: external, from: [COMPLETED, CANCELED], to: ARCHIVED }
    metrics:
      problems_opened:
        description: Problems opened, by month.
        source: objects
        item: p
        dimensions:
          month: month(p.created_at)
        time_dimension: p.created_at
        expression: count()

  ChangeWindow:
    description: A maintenance window, or a freeze window in which no change should be implemented.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      kind:      { type: WindowKind, indexed: true }
      starts_at: { type: timestamp, indexed: true }
      ends_at:   { type: timestamp, indexed: true }
    states:
      SCHEDULED: { category: active }
      WITHDRAWN: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      schedule: { kind: initial, to: SCHEDULED, required_inputs: [kind, starts_at, ends_at] }
      withdraw: { kind: external, from: SCHEDULED, to: WITHDRAWN }

  Change:
    description: A change to a service, reviewed by a peer and the change advisory board unless it is a standard change.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:          { type: string }
      change_type:      { type: ChangeType }
      risk:             { type: Risk, optional: true }
      affected_service: { reference: RegisteredService, opposite: changes }
      problem:          { reference: Problem, optional: true, opposite: changes }
      planned_start:    { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      planned_end:      { type: timestamp, optional: true }
    observations:
      approvals:
        kind: ChangeApproval
        description: One reviewer's decision at a review stage.
        attributes:
          stage:    { type: ReviewStage }
          approver: { type: identity }
          decision: { type: Decision }
    states:
      PEER_REVIEW:             { category: pending }
      PLANNING:                { category: active }
      AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL:   { category: pending, required_attributes: [planned_start, planned_end] }
      AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION: { category: waiting }
      IMPLEMENTING:            { category: active }
      COMPLETED:               { category: closed }
      DECLINED:                { category: closed }
      CANCELED:                { category: closed }
      ARCHIVED:                { category: closed, final: true }
    conditions:
      standard:
        description: The change is a standard change, pre-authorized and needing no review.
        expression: inputs.change_type == ChangeType.STANDARD
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      emergency:
        description: The change is an emergency change, whose authorization is fast-tracked.
        expression: change_type == ChangeType.EMERGENCY
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      peer_approved:
        description: A peer or the change manager has approved it since it entered review.
        expression: >-
          any(o in approvals where o.stage == ReviewStage.PEER and o.decision == Decision.APPROVE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(PEER_REVIEW))
        remedy: dependent
      cab_approved:
        description: Every change approver of the affected service has approved it since it awaited the board.
        expression: >-
          all(a in affected_service.change_approvers: any(o in approvals where o.stage == ReviewStage.CAB
              and o.approver == a and o.decision == Decision.APPROVE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL)))
        remedy: dependent
      declined:
        description: A reviewer has declined it.
        expression: any(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.DECLINE and o.occurred_at > entered_at(PEER_REVIEW))
        remedy: dependent
      outside_freeze:
        description: Its planned start falls in no freeze window.
        expression: >-
          none(w in ChangeWindow where w.kind == WindowKind.FREEZE and w.state == ChangeWindow.SCHEDULED
               and w.starts_at <= planned_start and planned_start < w.ends_at)
        remedy: dependent
    transitions:
      request:
        kind: initial
        to: PEER_REVIEW
        required_inputs: [summary, change_type, affected_service]
        optional_inputs: [risk, problem]
      request_standard:
        kind: initial
        to: PLANNING
        description: Records a standard change, which goes straight to planning, pre-authorized.
        required_inputs: [summary, change_type, affected_service]
        optional_inputs: [problem]
        guards:
          standard: deny
      approve_peer:
        kind: external
        from: PEER_REVIEW
        to: PLANNING
        guards:
          peer_approved: deny
      expedite:
        kind: external
        from: PEER_REVIEW
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        description: Fast-tracks an emergency change a peer has approved.
        guards:
          emergency: deny
          peer_approved: deny
      submit_to_cab:
        kind: external
        from: PLANNING
        to: AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL
        required_inputs: [planned_start, planned_end]
      approve_cab:
        kind: external
        from: AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        guards:
          cab_approved: deny
          outside_freeze: deny
      decline:
        kind: external
        from: [PEER_REVIEW, AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL]
        to: DECLINED
        guards:
          declined: deny
      implement:
        kind: external
        from: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        to: IMPLEMENTING
        description: Starts implementing; a deployment pipeline that gates on the change requests it.
      roll_back:
        kind: external
        from: IMPLEMENTING
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        description: Returns a change whose deployment failed or was canceled.
      complete: { kind: external, from: IMPLEMENTING, to: COMPLETED }
      cancel:
        kind: external
        from: [PEER_REVIEW, PLANNING, AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL, AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION]
        to: CANCELED
      archive: { kind: external, from: [COMPLETED, DECLINED, CANCELED], to: ARCHIVED }

  Alert:
    description: An alert from monitoring, deduplicated by its alias while it is open.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      alias:
        type: string
        indexed: true
        unique: { where: state == OPEN }
        description: One open alert at a time has an alias; a repeat of it counts on the open one.
      message:       { type: string }
      priority:      { type: AlertPriority }
      occurrences:   { type: int }
      acknowledged:  { type: bool }
      snoozed_until: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      incident:      { reference: Incident, optional: true, opposite: alerts }
    states:
      OPEN:    { category: active }
      CLOSED:  { category: closed }
      DELETED: { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      needs_escalation:
        description: The alert has been open and unacknowledged for five minutes, which the application's escalation reads.
        expression: not acknowledged and entered_at(OPEN) + 5 min <= now
    conditions:
      snooze_within_a_week:
        description: A snooze ends within seven days.
        expression: inputs.snoozed_until <= now + 7 days
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      create:
        kind: initial
        to: OPEN
        required_inputs: [alias, message, priority]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: occurrences, expr: "1" }
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      repeat:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        description: Counts a repeat of the alert, which the integration requests when an alert with its alias arrives.
        effect:
          - assign: { location: occurrences, expr: occurrences + 1 }
      acknowledge:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "true" }
      unacknowledge:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      snooze:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        required_inputs: [snoozed_until]
        guards:
          snooze_within_a_week: deny
      link_incident:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, CLOSED]
        required_inputs: [incident]
      close: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: CLOSED }
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: CLOSED
        to: OPEN
        description: Reopens the alert, which must be acknowledged again.
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      delete: { kind: external, from: CLOSED, to: DELETED }

  Asset:
    description: A configuration item in the asset schema, the base of every kind of asset; it has no objects of its own.
    abstract: true
    tracking: serial
    attributes:
      key:
        type: string
        identifier: { sequence: asset_key, format: "IT-{n}" }
        unique: true
      name:      { type: string }
      service:   { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true, opposite: assets }
      incidents: { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: asset }

  Laptop:
    description: A laptop, assigned to the person who uses it.
    extends: Asset
    state_machine: AssetLifecycle
    attributes:
      assigned_to: { reference: Employee, optional: true }
    transitions:
      assign:
        kind: internal
        from: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [assigned_to]

  Server:
    description: A server, known on the network by its host name.
    extends: Asset
    state_machine: AssetLifecycle
    attributes:
      hostname: { type: string, optional: true }
    transitions:
      name_host:
        kind: internal
        from: [IN_STOCK, IN_USE]
        required_inputs: [hostname]

  Employee:
    description: A person employed by the organization, as the HR system records them; the HR system owns the record, and only the import writes it.
    mirror: true
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      employee_id: { type: string, external: hr, indexed: true }
      name:        { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      department:  { type: string, optional: true }
    states:
      EMPLOYED: { category: active }
      LEFT:     { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      forget:
        kind: erasure
        description: Erases this store's copy of the person's name; the HR system erases its own.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }

  PartStock:
    description: The stock of one spare part, counted rather than tracked one by one.
    tracking: quantity
    attributes:
      part_number:   { type: string, indexed: true, unique: true }
      on_hand:       { type: counter, indexed: true }
      reserved:      { type: counter, indexed: true }
      reorder_level: { type: int, default: "5" }
    states:
      STOCKED:   { category: active }
      WITHDRAWN: { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      available:
        description: The parts on hand and not reserved; a query may filter on it.
        expression: on_hand - reserved
        indexed: true
      below_reorder_level:
        description: Fewer parts are available than the level at which more are ordered.
        expression: on_hand - reserved < reorder_level
    invariants:
      reserved_bounded:
        description: No more parts are reserved than are on hand.
        expression: reserved >= 0 and reserved <= on_hand
    conditions:
      enough_available:
        description: Enough parts are available for the reservation.
        expression: on_hand - reserved >= inputs.quantity
        remedy: dependent
      enough_reserved:
        description: At least as many parts are reserved as are released or used.
        expression: reserved >= inputs.quantity
        remedy: self_serviceable
      empty:
        description: None of the part is on hand.
        expression: on_hand == 0
        remedy: dependent
    transitions:
      open:
        kind: initial
        to: STOCKED
        required_inputs: [part_number]
      set_reorder_level:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        required_inputs: [reorder_level]
      receive:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        effect:
          - assign: { location: on_hand, expr: on_hand + inputs.quantity }
      reserve:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_available: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved + inputs.quantity }
      release:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_reserved: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved - inputs.quantity }
      use:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        description: Takes reserved parts out of stock, as a change or a request that needed them is carried out.
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_reserved: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved - inputs.quantity }
          - assign: { location: on_hand, expr: on_hand - inputs.quantity }
      withdraw:
        kind: external
        from: STOCKED
        to: WITHDRAWN
        guards:
          empty: deny

metrics:
  problems_per_incident:
    description: Problems opened for each incident opened, by month, which says how much of the incident load is being traced to a cause.
    input_metrics:
      problems: Problem.problems_opened
      incidents: Incident.incidents_opened
    group_by: [month]
    expression: problems * 1.000 / incidents
    flag_when: { few_traced: "value < 0.1" }

{"servicedesk":"# yaml-language-server: $schema=../flow.schema.json
# Service desk: Jira Service Management's IT service management flows, written in
# this format to check how much of them it can express (case-study-tickets.md §7).
# Statuses are those Atlassian lists as Jira Service Management's defaults.
module: servicedesk
categories: [waiting, active, pending, inactive]

enumerations:
  Priority: [HIGHEST, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, LOWEST]
  Level: [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW]
  Resolution: [DONE, WONT_DO, DUPLICATE, KNOWN_ERROR, HARDWARE_FAILURE, SOFTWARE_FAILURE]
  RequestType: [GET_IT_HELP, REQUEST_ACCESS, NEW_HARDWARE]
  ChangeType: [STANDARD, NORMAL, EMERGENCY]
  Risk: [LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH]
  Decision: [APPROVE, DECLINE]
  ReviewStage: [PEER, CAB]
  WindowKind: [MAINTENANCE, FREEZE]
  AlertPriority: [P1, P2, P3, P4, P5]
  SupportLevel: [STANDARD, PLATINUM]

sequences:
  asset_key:
    description: Numbers the configuration items of the asset schema, as IT-42.

machines:
  AssetLifecycle:
    description: An asset's status, active, pending or inactive, from receipt to disposal.
    requires:
      attributes:
        name:    { type: string }
        service: { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true }
    states:
      IN_STOCK: { category: pending }
      IN_USE:   { category: active }
      RETIRED:  { category: inactive }
      DISPOSED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      receive: { kind: initial, to: IN_STOCK, required_inputs: [name] }
      deploy:  { kind: external, from: IN_STOCK, to: IN_USE, optional_inputs: [service] }
      retire:  { kind: external, from: [IN_STOCK, IN_USE], to: RETIRED }
      dispose: { kind: external, from: RETIRED, to: DISPOSED }

types:
  Organization:
    description: A group of customers whose requests are shared among its members.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      name:          { type: string }
      support_level: { type: SupportLevel }
      requests:      { reference: "Request[]", opposite: organization }
    states:
      ACTIVE:   { category: active }
      ARCHIVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      create:  { kind: initial, to: ACTIVE, required_inputs: [name, support_level] }
      archive: { kind: external, from: ACTIVE, to: ARCHIVED }

  RegisteredService:
    description: A service in the service registry, with the people who respond to its incidents and approve its changes.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      name:             { type: string }
      tier:             { type: int }
      responders:       { type: "identity[]" }
      change_approvers: { type: "identity[]" }
      incidents:        { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: affected_service }
      changes:          { reference: "Change[]", opposite: affected_service }
      assets:           { reference: "Asset[]", opposite: service }
    states:
      OPERATIONAL: { category: active }
      RETIRED:     { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      register: { kind: initial, to: OPERATIONAL, required_inputs: [name, tier, responders, change_approvers] }
      retire:   { kind: external, from: OPERATIONAL, to: RETIRED }

  Request:
    description: A service request raised by a customer, approved where it needs to be, and measured against its SLA goals.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:            { type: string }
      request_type:       { type: RequestType }
      reporter:           { type: identity, description: The customer who raised it. }
      organization:       { reference: Organization, optional: true, opposite: requests }
      participants:       { type: "identity[]" }
      approvers:          { type: "identity[]" }
      approvals_required: { type: int, optional: true, description: How many approvals it needs; all of its approvers when absent. }
      priority:           { type: Priority, default: Priority.MEDIUM, description: A customer's request is medium until an agent says otherwise. }
      opened_at:          { type: timestamp }
      resolution:         { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      resolved_at:        { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      sla_met:            { type: bool, optional: true, description: "Whether the resolution goal was met, fixed when it was resolved." }
    observations:
      replies:
        kind: PublicReply
        description: A comment visible to the customer.
        attributes:
          body: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      notes:
        kind: InternalNote
        description: A comment the service team alone sees; who may read it is the application's.
        attributes:
          body: { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      approvals:
        kind: RequestApproval
        description: One approver's decision on the request.
        attributes:
          approver: { type: identity }
          decision: { type: Decision }
      ratings:
        kind: SatisfactionRating
        description: The customer's rating of how the request was handled.
        attributes:
          score: { type: int }
        invariants:
          in_range:
            description: A score is from 1 to 5.
            expression: score >= 1 and score <= 5
    states:
      WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL: { category: pending }
      WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT:  { category: waiting }
      IN_PROGRESS:          { category: active }
      WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER: { category: pending }
      PENDING:              { category: pending }
      ESCALATED:            { category: active }
      RESOLVED:
        description: Resolved, and awaiting the customer's verification.
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [resolution]
      DECLINED:  { category: closed }
      CANCELED:  { category: closed }
      CLOSED:
        description: Finished; the resolution is correct.
        category: closed
        final: true
    derived_attributes:
      approvals_needed:
        description: The approvals the request needs, a given number or all of its approvers.
        expression: if approvals_required is not null then approvals_required else count(a in approvers)
      resolution_goal:
        description: The time to resolution its SLA allows, by priority, and shorter for a platinum organization.
        expression: >-
          if organization is not null and organization.support_level == SupportLevel.PLATINUM then 2 h
          else if priority == Priority.HIGHEST or priority == Priority.HIGH then 4 h
          else if priority == Priority.MEDIUM then 8 h else 16 h
      time_to_resolution:
        description: Time spent on the request, paused while it waits for the customer or is pending.
        expression: >-
          sum(i in this.intervals where i.state != WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER and i.state != PENDING
              and i.state != WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL and i.state != RESOLVED and i.state != DECLINED
              and i.state != CANCELED and i.state != CLOSED: i.duration)
      resolution_breached:
        description: The request has taken longer than its goal.
        expression: time_to_resolution > resolution_goal
      paused:
        description: The request's SLA clock is paused.
        expression: state == WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER or state == PENDING
      time_to_first_response:
        description: From opening to the first comment the customer can see.
        expression: >-
          min(r in replies: r.occurred_at) - opened_at
    summary: [summary, request_type, priority, state]
    conditions:
      has_approvers:
        description: At least one approver is named.
        expression: count(a in inputs.approvers) >= 1
        remedy: self_serviceable
      approved:
        description: Enough approvers other than the reporter have approved since the request began waiting for approval.
        expression: >-
          count(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.APPROVE and o.approver != reporter
                and o.occurred_at > entered_at(WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL)) >= approvals_needed
        remedy: dependent
      declined:
        description: An approver has declined since the request began waiting for approval.
        expression: >-
          any(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.DECLINE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL))
        remedy: dependent
      resolved_three_days:
        description: The request has been resolved for three days.
        expression: entered_at(RESOLVED) + 3 days <= now
        remedy: temporal
    transitions:
      raise:
        kind: initial
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: Raises a request that needs no approval.
        required_inputs: [summary, request_type, reporter]
        optional_inputs: [organization]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      raise_for_approval:
        kind: initial
        to: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        description: Raises a request that its approvers must approve first.
        required_inputs: [summary, request_type, reporter, approvers]
        optional_inputs: [organization, approvals_required]
        guards:
          has_approvers: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      approve:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        guards:
          approved: deny
      decline:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL
        to: DECLINED
        guards:
          declined: deny
      start:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, ESCALATED]
        to: IN_PROGRESS
      respond_to_customer:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED]
        to: WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER
      customer_replies:
        kind: external
        from: WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: The customer answers, and the request waits for the team again.
      pend:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS]
        to: PENDING
      resume:
        kind: external
        from: PENDING
        to: IN_PROGRESS
      escalate:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS]
        to: ESCALATED
      prioritise:
        kind: internal
        from: [WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        description: Sets the priority an agent judges the request to have.
        required_inputs: [priority]
      share:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        description: Shares the request with another customer, who becomes a participant.
        inputs:
          with: { type: identity }
        effect:
          - add: { location: participants, expr: inputs.with }
      resolve:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED, PENDING]
        to: RESOLVED
        required_inputs: [resolution]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: resolved_at, expr: now }
          - assign: { location: sla_met, expr: time_to_resolution <= resolution_goal }
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT
        description: Reopens a resolved request, as a customer's comment on it does.
        effect:
          - clear: [resolution, resolved_at, sla_met]
      cancel:
        kind: external
        from: [WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, WAITING_FOR_SUPPORT, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        to: CANCELED
      close:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: CLOSED
        description: Closes a request resolved three days ago; a schedule in the application requests it.
        guards:
          resolved_three_days: deny
    metrics:
      sla_success:
        description: The share of resolved requests that met their resolution goal, by month.
        source: objects
        item: r
        filter: r.sla_met is not null
        dimensions:
          month: month(r.resolved_at)
        time_dimension: r.resolved_at
        expression: count(where r.sla_met) * 1.000 / count()
      labels_by_state:
        description: How often each label is applied to requests, by the state they were in, which shows where the flow and the work disagree.
        source: labels
        item: l
        dimensions:
          name: l.name
          state: l.subject_state
        time_dimension: l.occurred_at
        expression: count()
      satisfaction:
        description: The average satisfaction score, by month.
        source: ratings
        item: s
        dimensions:
          month: month(s.occurred_at)
        time_dimension: s.occurred_at
        expression: avg(s.score)

  Incident:
    description: An unplanned disruption to a service, prioritised by its impact and urgency.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:          { type: string }
      impact:           { type: Level }
      urgency:          { type: Level }
      major:            { type: bool }
      affected_service: { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      asset:            { reference: Asset, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      problem:          { reference: Problem, optional: true, opposite: incidents }
      responders:       { type: "identity[]" }
      opened_at:        { type: timestamp }
      resolution:       { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      alerts:           { reference: "Alert[]", opposite: incident }
      reviews:          { reference: "PostIncidentReview[]", opposite: primary_incident }
    observations:
      timeline:
        kind: StakeholderUpdate
        description: An update to the incident's stakeholders, on its timeline.
        attributes:
          message: { type: string }
    states:
      OPEN:             { category: waiting }
      WORK_IN_PROGRESS: { category: active }
      PENDING:          { category: pending }
      ESCALATED:        { category: active }
      RESOLVED:
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [resolution]
      CANCELED: { category: closed }
      CLOSED:   { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      priority:
        description: The priority its impact and urgency give it, by the impact and urgency matrix.
        expression: >-
          if impact == Level.CRITICAL and urgency == Level.CRITICAL then Priority.HIGHEST
          else if impact == Level.CRITICAL or urgency == Level.CRITICAL then Priority.HIGH
          else if impact == Level.LOW and urgency == Level.LOW then Priority.LOW
          else Priority.MEDIUM
      time_to_resolution:
        description: Time spent on the incident, paused while it is pending.
        expression: >-
          sum(i in this.intervals where i.state != PENDING and i.state != RESOLVED
              and i.state != CANCELED and i.state != CLOSED: i.duration)
      problem_open:
        description: The problem that causes the incident is still open, which Jira Service Management reports by automation.
        expression: problem is not null and problem.state.category != closed
    conditions:
      resolved_three_days:
        description: The incident has been resolved for three days.
        expression: entered_at(RESOLVED) + 3 days <= now
        remedy: temporal
    transitions:
      open:
        kind: initial
        to: OPEN
        required_inputs: [summary, impact, urgency, major, responders]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: opened_at, expr: now }
      investigate: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS }
      pend:        { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS], to: PENDING }
      resume:      { kind: external, from: PENDING, to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS }
      escalate:    { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS], to: ESCALATED }
      mark_major:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: major, expr: "true" }
      set_affected_service:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED]
        description: Sets the affected service, whose responders join the incident's.
        required_inputs: [affected_service]
        effect:
          - foreach:
              item: r
              array: inputs.affected_service.responders
              limit: 100
              steps:
                - add: { location: responders, expr: r }
      link_problem:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        required_inputs: [problem]
      link_asset:
        kind: internal
        from: any
        description: Names the asset the incident affects, a configuration item of the asset schema.
        required_inputs: [asset]
      resolve:
        kind: external
        from: [WORK_IN_PROGRESS, ESCALATED, PENDING]
        to: RESOLVED
        required_inputs: [resolution]
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: WORK_IN_PROGRESS
        effect:
          - clear: [resolution]
      cancel: { kind: external, from: [OPEN, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, ESCALATED], to: CANCELED }
      close:
        kind: external
        from: RESOLVED
        to: CLOSED
        guards:
          resolved_three_days: deny
      create_review:
        kind: internal
        from: [RESOLVED]
        description: Creates a post-incident review with this incident as its primary incident.
        inputs:
          title: { type: string }
        effect:
          - create: { type: PostIncidentReview, transition: draft, inputs: { primary_incident: this, title: inputs.title } }
    metrics:
      incidents_opened:
        description: Incidents opened, by month.
        source: objects
        item: i
        dimensions:
          month: month(i.created_at)
        time_dimension: i.created_at
        expression: count()

  PostIncidentReview:
    description: A review of why an incident happened and how to prevent it.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      title:            { type: string }
      primary_incident: { reference: Incident, opposite: reviews }
      findings:         { type: string, optional: true }
    states:
      DRAFT:     { category: active }
      PUBLISHED: { category: closed, required_attributes: [findings] }
      ARCHIVED:  { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      draft:   { kind: initial, to: DRAFT, required_inputs: [primary_incident, title] }
      publish: { kind: external, from: DRAFT, to: PUBLISHED, required_inputs: [findings] }
      archive: { kind: external, from: [DRAFT, PUBLISHED], to: ARCHIVED }

  Problem:
    description: The cause, or possible cause, of one or more incidents.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:    { type: string }
      root_cause: { type: string, optional: true }
      workaround: { type: string, optional: true }
      resolution: { type: Resolution, optional: true }
      incidents:  { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: problem }
      changes:    { reference: "Change[]", opposite: problem }
    states:
      OPEN:                { category: waiting }
      UNDER_INVESTIGATION: { category: active }
      UNDER_REVIEW:
        category: active
        required_attributes: [root_cause]
      COMPLETED:
        category: closed
        required_attributes: [root_cause, resolution]
      CANCELED: { category: closed }
      ARCHIVED: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      open:        { kind: initial, to: OPEN, required_inputs: [summary] }
      investigate: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: UNDER_INVESTIGATION }
      review:
        kind: external
        from: UNDER_INVESTIGATION
        to: UNDER_REVIEW
        required_inputs: [root_cause]
        optional_inputs: [workaround]
      complete:
        kind: external
        from: UNDER_REVIEW
        to: COMPLETED
        description: Completes the problem; a documented workaround makes it a known error.
        required_inputs: [resolution]
      cancel:  { kind: external, from: [OPEN, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, UNDER_REVIEW], to: CANCELED }
      archive: { kind: external, from: [COMPLETED, CANCELED], to: ARCHIVED }
    metrics:
      problems_opened:
        description: Problems opened, by month.
        source: objects
        item: p
        dimensions:
          month: month(p.created_at)
        time_dimension: p.created_at
        expression: count()

  ChangeWindow:
    description: A maintenance window, or a freeze window in which no change should be implemented.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      kind:      { type: WindowKind, indexed: true }
      starts_at: { type: timestamp, indexed: true }
      ends_at:   { type: timestamp, indexed: true }
    states:
      SCHEDULED: { category: active }
      WITHDRAWN: { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      schedule: { kind: initial, to: SCHEDULED, required_inputs: [kind, starts_at, ends_at] }
      withdraw: { kind: external, from: SCHEDULED, to: WITHDRAWN }

  Change:
    description: A change to a service, reviewed by a peer and the change advisory board unless it is a standard change.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      summary:          { type: string }
      change_type:      { type: ChangeType }
      risk:             { type: Risk, optional: true }
      affected_service: { reference: RegisteredService, opposite: changes }
      problem:          { reference: Problem, optional: true, opposite: changes }
      planned_start:    { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      planned_end:      { type: timestamp, optional: true }
    observations:
      approvals:
        kind: ChangeApproval
        description: One reviewer's decision at a review stage.
        attributes:
          stage:    { type: ReviewStage }
          approver: { type: identity }
          decision: { type: Decision }
    states:
      PEER_REVIEW:             { category: pending }
      PLANNING:                { category: active }
      AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL:   { category: pending, required_attributes: [planned_start, planned_end] }
      AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION: { category: waiting }
      IMPLEMENTING:            { category: active }
      COMPLETED:               { category: closed }
      DECLINED:                { category: closed }
      CANCELED:                { category: closed }
      ARCHIVED:                { category: closed, final: true }
    conditions:
      standard:
        description: The change is a standard change, pre-authorized and needing no review.
        expression: inputs.change_type == ChangeType.STANDARD
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      emergency:
        description: The change is an emergency change, whose authorization is fast-tracked.
        expression: change_type == ChangeType.EMERGENCY
        remedy: unreachable_from_here
      peer_approved:
        description: A peer or the change manager has approved it since it entered review.
        expression: >-
          any(o in approvals where o.stage == ReviewStage.PEER and o.decision == Decision.APPROVE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(PEER_REVIEW))
        remedy: dependent
      cab_approved:
        description: Every change approver of the affected service has approved it since it awaited the board.
        expression: >-
          all(a in affected_service.change_approvers: any(o in approvals where o.stage == ReviewStage.CAB
              and o.approver == a and o.decision == Decision.APPROVE
              and o.occurred_at > entered_at(AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL)))
        remedy: dependent
      declined:
        description: A reviewer has declined it.
        expression: any(o in approvals where o.decision == Decision.DECLINE and o.occurred_at > entered_at(PEER_REVIEW))
        remedy: dependent
      outside_freeze:
        description: Its planned start falls in no freeze window.
        expression: >-
          none(w in ChangeWindow where w.kind == WindowKind.FREEZE and w.state == ChangeWindow.SCHEDULED
               and w.starts_at <= planned_start and planned_start < w.ends_at)
        remedy: dependent
    transitions:
      request:
        kind: initial
        to: PEER_REVIEW
        required_inputs: [summary, change_type, affected_service]
        optional_inputs: [risk, problem]
      request_standard:
        kind: initial
        to: PLANNING
        description: Records a standard change, which goes straight to planning, pre-authorized.
        required_inputs: [summary, change_type, affected_service]
        optional_inputs: [problem]
        guards:
          standard: deny
      approve_peer:
        kind: external
        from: PEER_REVIEW
        to: PLANNING
        guards:
          peer_approved: deny
      expedite:
        kind: external
        from: PEER_REVIEW
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        description: Fast-tracks an emergency change a peer has approved.
        guards:
          emergency: deny
          peer_approved: deny
      submit_to_cab:
        kind: external
        from: PLANNING
        to: AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL
        required_inputs: [planned_start, planned_end]
      approve_cab:
        kind: external
        from: AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        guards:
          cab_approved: deny
          outside_freeze: deny
      decline:
        kind: external
        from: [PEER_REVIEW, AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL]
        to: DECLINED
        guards:
          declined: deny
      implement:
        kind: external
        from: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        to: IMPLEMENTING
        description: Starts implementing; a deployment pipeline that gates on the change requests it.
      roll_back:
        kind: external
        from: IMPLEMENTING
        to: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION
        description: Returns a change whose deployment failed or was canceled.
      complete: { kind: external, from: IMPLEMENTING, to: COMPLETED }
      cancel:
        kind: external
        from: [PEER_REVIEW, PLANNING, AWAITING_CAB_APPROVAL, AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION]
        to: CANCELED
      archive: { kind: external, from: [COMPLETED, DECLINED, CANCELED], to: ARCHIVED }

  Alert:
    description: An alert from monitoring, deduplicated by its alias while it is open.
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      alias:
        type: string
        indexed: true
        unique: { where: state == OPEN }
        description: One open alert at a time has an alias; a repeat of it counts on the open one.
      message:       { type: string }
      priority:      { type: AlertPriority }
      occurrences:   { type: int }
      acknowledged:  { type: bool }
      snoozed_until: { type: timestamp, optional: true }
      incident:      { reference: Incident, optional: true, opposite: alerts }
    states:
      OPEN:    { category: active }
      CLOSED:  { category: closed }
      DELETED: { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      needs_escalation:
        description: The alert has been open and unacknowledged for five minutes, which the application's escalation reads.
        expression: not acknowledged and entered_at(OPEN) + 5 min <= now
    conditions:
      snooze_within_a_week:
        description: A snooze ends within seven days.
        expression: inputs.snoozed_until <= now + 7 days
        remedy: self_serviceable
    transitions:
      create:
        kind: initial
        to: OPEN
        required_inputs: [alias, message, priority]
        effect:
          - assign: { location: occurrences, expr: "1" }
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      repeat:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        description: Counts a repeat of the alert, which the integration requests when an alert with its alias arrives.
        effect:
          - assign: { location: occurrences, expr: occurrences + 1 }
      acknowledge:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "true" }
      unacknowledge:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      snooze:
        kind: internal
        from: OPEN
        required_inputs: [snoozed_until]
        guards:
          snooze_within_a_week: deny
      link_incident:
        kind: internal
        from: [OPEN, CLOSED]
        required_inputs: [incident]
      close: { kind: external, from: OPEN, to: CLOSED }
      reopen:
        kind: external
        from: CLOSED
        to: OPEN
        description: Reopens the alert, which must be acknowledged again.
        effect:
          - assign: { location: acknowledged, expr: "false" }
      delete: { kind: external, from: CLOSED, to: DELETED }

  Asset:
    description: A configuration item in the asset schema, the base of every kind of asset; it has no objects of its own.
    abstract: true
    tracking: serial
    attributes:
      key:
        type: string
        identifier: { sequence: asset_key, format: "IT-{n}" }
        unique: true
      name:      { type: string }
      service:   { reference: RegisteredService, optional: true, opposite: assets }
      incidents: { reference: "Incident[]", opposite: asset }

  Laptop:
    description: A laptop, assigned to the person who uses it.
    extends: Asset
    state_machine: AssetLifecycle
    attributes:
      assigned_to: { reference: Employee, optional: true }
    transitions:
      assign:
        kind: internal
        from: IN_USE
        required_inputs: [assigned_to]

  Server:
    description: A server, known on the network by its host name.
    extends: Asset
    state_machine: AssetLifecycle
    attributes:
      hostname: { type: string, optional: true }
    transitions:
      name_host:
        kind: internal
        from: [IN_STOCK, IN_USE]
        required_inputs: [hostname]

  Employee:
    description: A person employed by the organization, as the HR system records them; the HR system owns the record, and only the import writes it.
    mirror: true
    tracking: record
    attributes:
      employee_id: { type: string, external: hr, indexed: true }
      name:        { type: string, optional: true, personal: true }
      department:  { type: string, optional: true }
    states:
      EMPLOYED: { category: active }
      LEFT:     { category: closed, final: true }
    transitions:
      forget:
        kind: erasure
        description: Erases this store's copy of the person's name; the HR system erases its own.
        inputs:
          reason: { type: string }

  PartStock:
    description: The stock of one spare part, counted rather than tracked one by one.
    tracking: quantity
    attributes:
      part_number:   { type: string, indexed: true, unique: true }
      on_hand:       { type: counter, indexed: true }
      reserved:      { type: counter, indexed: true }
      reorder_level: { type: int, default: "5" }
    states:
      STOCKED:   { category: active }
      WITHDRAWN: { category: closed, final: true }
    derived_attributes:
      available:
        description: The parts on hand and not reserved; a query may filter on it.
        expression: on_hand - reserved
        indexed: true
      below_reorder_level:
        description: Fewer parts are available than the level at which more are ordered.
        expression: on_hand - reserved < reorder_level
    invariants:
      reserved_bounded:
        description: No more parts are reserved than are on hand.
        expression: reserved >= 0 and reserved <= on_hand
    conditions:
      enough_available:
        description: Enough parts are available for the reservation.
        expression: on_hand - reserved >= inputs.quantity
        remedy: dependent
      enough_reserved:
        description: At least as many parts are reserved as are released or used.
        expression: reserved >= inputs.quantity
        remedy: self_serviceable
      empty:
        description: None of the part is on hand.
        expression: on_hand == 0
        remedy: dependent
    transitions:
      open:
        kind: initial
        to: STOCKED
        required_inputs: [part_number]
      set_reorder_level:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        required_inputs: [reorder_level]
      receive:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        effect:
          - assign: { location: on_hand, expr: on_hand + inputs.quantity }
      reserve:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_available: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved + inputs.quantity }
      release:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_reserved: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved - inputs.quantity }
      use:
        kind: internal
        from: STOCKED
        description: Takes reserved parts out of stock, as a change or a request that needed them is carried out.
        inputs:
          quantity: { type: int }
        guards:
          enough_reserved: deny
        effect:
          - assign: { location: reserved, expr: reserved - inputs.quantity }
          - assign: { location: on_hand, expr: on_hand - inputs.quantity }
      withdraw:
        kind: external
        from: STOCKED
        to: WITHDRAWN
        guards:
          empty: deny

metrics:
  problems_per_incident:
    description: Problems opened for each incident opened, by month, which says how much of the incident load is being traced to a cause.
    input_metrics:
      problems: Problem.problems_opened
      incidents: Incident.incidents_opened
    group_by: [month]
    expression: problems * 1.000 / incidents
    flag_when: { few_traced: "value < 0.1" }

"}
